## Services
- Websites & web platforms — business sites, landing and campaign pages, portals, content management, multi-language
- Design & brand experience — UI and UX design, design systems, prototypes before build
- E-commerce & storefronts — online stores, payments and checkout, inventory and orders, fulfilment flows, commerce analytics
- Custom software — business platforms, web applications, portals and marketplaces, data modelling, role-based access
- CRM & ERP systems — CRM setup and customisation, ERP workflows, lead and pipeline tracking, migration from legacy tools
- Internal tools & dashboards — admin panels, reporting dashboards, approval workflows, team and role management
- Business automation — quotes and follow-ups, scheduled reports, document generation, notifications, stock and order sync
- APIs & integrations — REST and GraphQL APIs, third-party integrations, payment and shipping gateways, webhooks and data sync
- WhatsApp & messaging — WhatsApp Business API, enquiry capture and routing, order and delivery updates, chatbots, broadcast campaigns
- SEO & search visibility — technical SEO, local and Google Maps visibility, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, search intent mapping
- Customisation & improvements — feature additions, redesigns and rebuilds, performance fixes, bug fixing, customising third-party software
- Support, hosting & performance — hosting and deployment, uptime monitoring, security updates, performance tuning, support retainers

## Outcomes those services are bought for
- Get found — search visibility built into the structure of the thing itself
- Get more customers — the path a buyer walks, with everything else removed
- Work smarter — the repetitive part of the week that should not need a person
- Build what's missing — the platform no vendor sells because only you need it
- Sell better — product experiences built for how people really decide
- Scale digitally — ongoing ownership rather than a handover and a goodbye

## How the work runs
1. Understand — how the business runs, and where the hours and money go
2. Identify — the real problem, separated from the obvious one
3. Strategize — what to build, improve, automate, or leave alone
4. Build — the solution shaped around you, not the other way round
5. Grow — visibility, speed and conversion, kept moving after launch

## Key Facts
- A focused website is usually 2–4 weeks; commerce platforms and custom systems typically 2–3 months
- The first conversation costs nothing; a fixed written quote follows a short discovery, with scope attached
- We work inside existing brand guidelines, codebases and systems, and improve rather than replace where replacing is not justified
- Ongoing support is a package, not an afterthought: performance, security, search visibility, analytics
- Languages: English, Hindi, Gujarati
- Hours: Mon–Sat, 09:00–19:00 IST

## Differentiators
- We find the real problem — discovery first, written diagnosis, scope you can refuse
- Built to be found — technical SEO, architecture and Core Web Vitals designed under from the first sitemap
- Built to fit — the system is shaped around how the work already runs, not around a template or a licence
- Still here after launch — performance, uptime, search visibility, quarterly review
